record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: The concept of irreducible elements in ordered Banach algebras was established in [ 1 ]. Several aspects of these elements, in particular the peripheral spectrum, still have to be investigated.

evidence.quote: The concept of irreducible elements in ordered Banach algebras was established in [ 1 ]. Several aspects of these elements, in particular the peripheral spectrum, still have to be investigated.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(A, \|\cdot\|, C)$ be an ordered Banach algebra with unit $e$, i.e., a real or complex Banach algebra together with a closed proper algebra cone $C \subseteq A$ (a closed subset containing $e$, closed under addition, nonnegative scalar multiplication, and multiplication, with $C \cap (-C) = \{0\}$). Write $a \ge 0$ if $a \in C$. An element $p \in C$ is called an order idempotent if $p^2 = p$ and $0 \le p \le e$. A positive element $a \in C$ is called irreducible if for every order idempotent $p$, the equality $(e-p)\,a\,p = 0$ forces $p = 0$ or $p = e$. For $a \in A$, denote by $\sigma(a)$ its spectrum, by $r(a)$ its spectral radius, and define the peripheral spectrum
$$\sigma_{\text{per}}(a) := \{\lambda \in \sigma(a) : |\lambda| = r(a)\}.$$

Investigate the peripheral spectrum of irreducible positive elements in such an ordered Banach algebra. Specifically, determine general conditions on $(A,C)$ and on an irreducible element $a \in C$ under which:
(i) $\sigma_{\text{per}}(a)$ coincides with $r(a) \cdot G$ for some finite cyclic subgroup $G$ of the unit circle (a rotational symmetry of the peripheral spectrum);
(ii) the full spectrum $\sigma(a)$ is invariant under multiplication by the elements of this cyclic group;
(iii) $r(a)$ is a simple pole of the resolvent of $a$ and is geometrically simple.

Provide a unified spectral theory extending the classical Perron–Frobenius and Krein–Rutman results for irreducible positive operators to the abstract setting of ordered Banach algebras.
artifact.status_search_result: Foundational work on irreducible elements in ordered Banach algebras was carried out by Alekhno (2012). Progress on the peripheral spectrum of irreducible/positive elements has been obtained, notably in Alekhno's 2018 paper "On the peripheral spectrum of positive elements" (Positivity), which establishes cyclicity-type results under additional hypotheses. However, a complete general theory paralleling the classical Perron–Frobenius results remains under active development, so the problem is partially solved.
